proposals.before: Place five chambers in this hall—even Ban and Yi designing, Wang Er planning—three chambers must occupy north and south.
proposals.after: Place five chambers in this hall—even Ban and Chui designing, Wang Er planning—three chambers must occupy north and south.
proposals.reason: Chinese 倕 is the craftsman Chui, not Yi; the idiomatic line mistranslates the name.

proposals.before: Place five chambers in this hall—even if Ban and Yi thought, Wang Er planned—they could not keep three chambers from occupying north and south.
proposals.after: Place five chambers in this hall—even if Ban and Chui thought, Wang Er planned—they could not keep three chambers from occupying north and south.
proposals.reason: Chinese 倕 is Chui; literal English wrongly renders it as Yi.

proposals.before: Though Dong Zhongshu never glanced into his garden, Cui Yuan shut his door, Gao drifted on the river, and Zhang forgot to eat—none equals this man.
proposals.after: Though Dong Zhongshu never glanced into his garden, Junbo shut his door, Gao let the grain drift, and Master Zhang forgot to eat—none equals this man.
proposals.reason: Chinese has 君伯 not Cui Yuan; 高氏之遺漂 is the drifted-grain study anecdote, not drifting on a river.

proposals.before: Though Dong Zhongshu did not peep into the garden, Cui Yuan shut his door, Gao's legacy drifted away, and Master Zhang forgot food—compared with this man, they are not enough for a likeness.
proposals.after: Though Dong Zhongshu did not peep into the garden, Junbo shut his door, Gao's grain was left to drift, and Master Zhang forgot food—compared with this man, they are not enough for a likeness.
proposals.reason: Cui Yuan does not match 君伯; 遺漂 refers to grain left to drift away while studying.

proposals.before: He told court gentlemen, "Zhen Chen's conduct shames no one, but he failed the court by not recommending Li Mi."
proposals.after: He told court gentlemen, "Zhen Chen's conduct does not shame the age, but he failed the court by not recommending Li Mi."
proposals.reason: Chinese 不媿時 means does not shame/fall short of the age, not 'shames no one'.

proposals.before: In youth he retired to Jigu Valley south of Qi, built cliff dwellings, lived alone in calm detachment, shunned worldly affairs, plowed and drank water, wore bark crown and grass robes, loved the classics, and devoted himself to the Way.
proposals.after: In youth he retired to Jigu Valley south of Qi, built cliff dwellings, lived alone in calm detachment, shunned worldly affairs, plowed and drank water, wore bark crown and grass robes, loved the classics and histories, and devoted himself to the mysterious Way.
proposals.reason: Chinese 雅好經史 includes histories; 玄門 is the mysterious/dark gate, not generic 'the Way' alone.

decisions.reason: 行不媿時 means his conduct does not shame the age; 'shames no one' drops 時 and invents 'no one'. The proposed idiomatic matches the phrase and the unit's literal.
雅好經史 requires classics and histories, and 專意玄門 is devotion to the mysterious/dark gate, not bare 'the Way'. The proposed idiomatic restores both.
